newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil to upgrade Statfjord North field.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to upgrade Statfjord North field.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it will upgrade the water injection system at the Statfjord North oil satellite, which will boost production and increase recoverable reserves by more than six million barrels.

Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said the upgrade was part of an overall solution for the northerly end of the Statfjord area, which will require the installation of a new turbine-driven pump on the Statfjord C platform.
Statoil said it would award a contract for the installation in September.
